tie_break: lowest unrounded validation RMSE; exact ties use first candidate in listed order
failed_fit_policy: record exception and resource limit; do not replace failed candidate or modify grid; a family with all failures has no selected fit
nonconvergence_policy: max_iter outputs remain eligible, explicitly labeled nonconverged; compare predictive performance not optimizer certificates
resource_policy: one BLAS thread; per-fit 120 second wall-time cap; process timeout counts as failure; no silent fallbacks
missing_item_policy: low-rank raw predictions are defined for globally indexed items even if not observed in training; report warm/cold item strata separately; no target leakage
evaluation_policy: validation is used once to select a candidate within each family; no additional grid expansion based on validation; test only after code and choices frozen
caveat: Earlier exploratory audits inspected this MovieLens dataset under other splits; this is not fully independent dataset-level confirmation.

baseline_implementation_29.objective: sum_training_squared_errors + regularization*(sum(user_bias**2)+sum(item_bias**2)); global mean fixed at training mean
baseline_implementation_29.algorithm: deterministic alternating exact ridge coordinate-block updates, users then items
baseline_implementation_29.stop: max absolute coordinate change <= tol, otherwise max_iter
baseline_implementation_29.unseen_policy: user or item absent in training retains zero bias
